title: Portable long service scheme (building and construction)
summary: This page provides information about the Portable long service scheme for the building and construction industry.
who_can_apply: Worker in the building and construction industry

internal_links.text: Manage your workers' portable long service (employer)
Manage your client’s portable long service (tax agent)

faqs.q: What is the Portable long service scheme?
faqs.a: The Portable long service scheme allows workers in the building and construction industry to accumulate and manage their long service entitlements across different employers.

faqs.q: Who can use the Portable long service scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme applies to workers in the building and construction industry.

faqs.q: How do I manage my portable long service?
faqs.a: Workers can manage their portable long service through the dedicated online service.
